items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Preston Love, who had replaced Earl Warren during the time... Earl Warren went back in the band so that Preston could go home and visit his family.

ctx.x: First alto, excellent musician, and he stayed just for a little while and then they picked up Earl Warren out of Cincinnati, because Earl Warren I'm pretty sure was playing with Al Sears in Cincinnati at the Ferguson Hotel there.
May I ask you who Caughey Roberts was?
